title: Surreal AI Music Video - There’s No Place Like Home - Wizard of Oz Inspired  - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
AI Music Video — “There’s No Place Like Home”
Back to my weird videos 🌪️ — this one has a surreal Wizard of Oz touch.
I made the song using Suno, created the visuals in Midjourney, and animated everything with Hailuo (MiniMax).

It’s my take on how AI tools can bring classic themes to life in new, unexpected ways. You might spot a few Oz-inspired moments along the way.

🎧 Tools Used:
• Suno – AI-generated song “There’s No Place Like Home”
• Midjourney – Visual concept and imagery
• Hailuo (MiniMax) – Animation and motion consistency

💬 Spot the Oz references?
Comment your favorite scene below — and subscribe for more AI art & music experiments.

#AI #AIArt #AIMusic #AIVideo #Suno #Midjourney #Hailuo #MiniMax #AIMusicVideo #AIWizardOfOz #KellyBoeschAIArt
